title: Climb Global Solutions Sets Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call for October 29, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET

# Climb Global Solutions Sets Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call for October 29, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET


October 15, 2026 8:30am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_e2be8b99fd19637d99dedbc7b3bd0329/waysidetechnology/news/2026-10-15_Climb_Global_Solutions_Sets_Third_Quarter_2026_248.pdf)


EATONTOWN, N.J., Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Climb Global Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ:CLMB) (“Climb” or the “Company”), a value-added global IT channel company providing unique sales and distribution solutions for innovative technology vendors, will host a conference call on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern time to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company’s results will be reported in a press release prior to the call.


Climb’s management will host the conference call, followed by a question-and-answer period. Interested parties may submit questions to the Company prior to the call by emailing[CLMB@elevate-ir.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9i_wtqMM3AdEkG8kxzghgVY3nl40nHlem-W_oKTv4vdEXfkIzhNiMfAJwULEh_JkPngi238BNYf9kjzoELl6esERLPDm198rPKjxLtk3JsI=) .


Date: Thursday, October 29, 2026
Time: 8:30 a.m. Eastern time
Toll-free dial-in number: (800) 267-6316
International dial-in number: (203) 518-9783
Conference ID: CLIMB
Webcast:[Climb’s Q3 2026 Conference Call](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=wxQbQt2WUpSQqafJU0ARbZZsUmmUk3bMV-vIo-6eNlp9ShkYuBHlGFXTgBCOqrQaCrcZ5gCKnSxTCFlY2Lc_E3RAWXxdJObMPkoyF8QO0lYvMiy7Snam9g9vNJmUiU0ubQ6B1fWFSSu5GJtnyrK3im9on-CB-HK_rKub5J8LpP8pfA-FbRM3-cKXj2OhS0JO)

**About Climb Global Solutions**


Climb Global Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ:CLMB) is a value-added global IT distribution and solutions company specializing in emerging and innovative technologies. Climb operates across the US, Canada and Europe through multiple business units, including Climb Channel Solutions, Grey Matter and Climb Global Services. The Company provides IT distribution and solutions for companies in the Security, Data Management, Connectivity, Storage & HCI, Virtualization & Cloud, and Software & ALM industries.
